newsitem.title: USA: CBOT CORN, SOYBEANS EDGE HIGHER ON SHORT COVERING.
newsitem.headline: CBOT CORN, SOYBEANS EDGE HIGHER ON SHORT COVERING.

text.p: U.S. grain and soy complex futures opening as of 0938 CDT.
WHEAT - Down 3/4 to up 1/4 cent a bushel - Technically overbought but corn turns higher early and lifts wheat. Continued talk that Egypt will tender this weekend.

CORN - Up 1-1/4 to 1/4 cent a bushel - Ideas Thursday's sell-off was overdone. Short covering. Trade unwilling to carry large positions into critical weather weekend amid expectations for volatile Sunday night and Monday trade.

SOYBEANS - Up four to 3/4 cents a bushel - Short covering ahead of what is expected to be critical weather weekend. Leslie crop production figure bearish but trade had already priced in a record crop. Still no deliveries.
SOY PRODUCTS - Soymeal up $1.00 per ton to down $0.30 while soyoil up 0.19 to 0.03 cent per lb.
